newhire_li: hi team! first day here. got a loaner intel mac and installed Homebrew, asdf, and fish. but `node` comes from /usr/local (intel brew) while asdf shims are in /opt/homebrew, and fish isn't picking up the asdf shims. getting "command not found" for some CLIs. any recommended fish snippets or Homebrew prefix tips? do i need Rosetta for anything?

oscar: welcome! loaner intel -> yep you'll have Homebrew under /usr/local. if you also installed apple-silicon brew later you'll get both prefixes which causes chaos. decide which brew to keep. for fish add to ~/.config/fish/config.fish:
```fish
set -gx PATH /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin $PATH
# initialize asdf installed via brew
source (brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.fish
set -gx PATH $HOME/.local/bin $PATH
```
That should surface asdf shims in fish.

devx_maya: FYI we prefer asdf-first for runtimes. If you have two brew installs remove the unwanted one: on intel-only machine keep /usr/local. No Rosetta needed unless running intel-only binaries on apple silicon. Also run `asdf reshim` after installs.

infra-bot: Onboarding guide: <internal/dev-setup/fish-asdf.md> includes fish examples and known brew-prefix issues.

newhire_li: thanks! quick Q: i have nvm stuff in my dotfiles too. should i remove nvm when using asdf-node?

oscar: remove nvm to avoid double shims. Check `which -a node` and `type node` to see what's first. `rm -rf ~/.nvm` and remove nvm lines from dotfiles if moving fully to asdf.

kate: for fish and pipx, install pipx into the asdf python: `python -m pip install --user pipx` then `pipx ensurepath`. In fish you might need to run `functions -c fish_user_paths fish_user_paths` or restart shell to pick up $HOME/.local/bin.

devx_maya: small tip: fish uses different rc ordering. Put brew/asdf PATH changes in config.fish before any eval of fisher or plugins. If you use direnv, fish needs `eval (direnv export fish)` in config.fish.

newhire_li: running `which -a node` shows `/usr/local/bin/node` then `/opt/homebrew/bin/asdf`. i'll uninstall one brew and re-source fish. if i still have issues i'll paste outputs: `which -a node`, `asdf current`, `echo $PATH`, `cat ~/.config/fish/config.fish`. thanks all! :rocket:
